description: Close the loop on a settled Solana Swap Guard swap. Present the signed guard decision the agent executed under plus the on-chain transaction signature. Insight verifies the decision, re-collects execution facts from Solana JSON-RPC, reconciles the observed SPL input and output balance deltas against the reviewed exact amounts (amountInRaw and the otherAmountThreshold minimum output), and returns a signed settlement bound to the decisionHash with an explicit status (SETTLED, REVERTED, or UNRECONCILED) and reconciliation code. A decision that does not verify is rejected. This is settlement evidence, not transaction authority, a price-correctness claim, or a guarantee of good timing.
name: settle_solana_swap_guard
